title: Now This Policy Witnesseth:
summary: The Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy outlines insurance coverage for loss or damage to insured vehicles and accessories due to various perils including fire, theft, natural disasters, riots, terrorist activities, and transit. It specifies depreciation rates for replaced parts based on material and vehicle age, with no depreciation for Non-OEM/Non-OES parts. Exclusions include consequential loss, wear and tear, mechanical breakdowns, overloading damage, and incidents under intoxication. Tyre and tube damage is covered only if the vehicle is damaged simultaneously, limited to 50% of replacement cost. The policy includes company contact and registration details.

title: SECTION I - LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED
summary: The Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy outlines coverage for loss or damage to insured commercial vehicles and accessories under Section I, including perils like fire, theft, natural disasters, riots, and transit, with depreciation rates for replaced parts and exclusions for consequential loss, wear and tear, and driving under influence. It details towing cost limits, repair authorization conditions, and the Sum Insured based on Insured's Declared Value (IDV) with age-wise depreciation schedules and CTL criteria. Section II covers liability to third parties for death, injury, and property damage from vehicle use, subject to policy limits and exclusions.

summary: The text outlines the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy, including UIN numbers and various sections. It details exclusions for loading/unloading, employee injuries, passenger liability, property damage, and bridge/road damage. It covers the company's payment of costs with consent, indemnification of permitted drivers, options for legal representation, and indemnification of personal representatives. Section III addresses towing disabled vehicles with conditions. Section IV provides personal accident cover for owner-drivers, specifying compensation scale, conditions, and nominee requirements. It also includes avoidance of certain terms and right of recovery under the Motor Vehicles Act, and general exceptions such as geographical area, contractual liability, unauthorized use/driver, and nuclear risks.

title: AVOIDANCE OF CERTAIN TERMS AND RIGHT OF RECOVERY
summary: The text outlines the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy, detailing compensation for owner-driver bodily injury or death with specific scales (100% for death, loss of two limbs/sight, or permanent total disablement; 50% for loss of one limb/sight), capped at Rs.15 lakhs per insurance period and payable under only one item per occurrence. It includes conditions, exclusions for intentional self-injury, suicide, or intoxication, and requirements for direct payment to insured/legal representatives. Coverage is subject to owner-driver being registered owner, named insured, and holding a valid driving license, with mandatory nominee details. It also covers avoidance of certain terms and right of recovery, general exceptions for geographical area, contractual liability, unauthorized use, property damage, and nuclear risks, and provides company contact information.

title: GENERAL EXCEPTIONS
summary: The text outlines the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy, detailing compensation for owner-driver bodily injury/death with a scale (100% for death or loss of two limbs/sight of two eyes or one limb and sight of one eye, 50% for loss of one limb or sight of one eye, 100% for permanent total disablement), limited to one item per occurrence and max Rs.15 lakhs per insurance period. Exclusions include intentional self-injury, suicide, physical defect/infirmity, and accidents under influence of liquor/drugs. Compensation is payable to insured or legal representatives. Cover conditions require owner-driver to be registered owner, named insured, and hold a valid driving license per Rule 3 of Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989; nominee details are mandatory. The policy does not affect rights under Motor Vehicles Act 1988, but insured must repay sums paid by company that it would not have been liable to pay but for said provisions. General exceptions exclude liability for loss/damage/liability outside Geographical Area, contractual liability, vehicle used contrary to Limitations as to Use or driven by unauthorized person, property damage/consequential loss, ionising radiations/radioactive contamination, nuclear weapons material, and war/invasion/hostilities/civil war/mutiny/rebellion/military or usurped power. Deductible applies to Section I claims as stated in Schedule. General conditions include policy and schedule read together, conditions precedent (premium paid before commencement, due observance of terms and truth of statements), and conditions during contract (duties after occurrence: immediate written notice, forward legal documents, notice of prosecution/inquest, police notice for theft/criminal act, no admission without consent, provide information).

nodes.title: Commercial Vehicle Policy: Exclusions, Transport Expenses, and Loss of Income
nodes.summary: This page from the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy outlines key exclusions and coverages. It begins with a requirement for a police report for burglary, house-breaking, or theft claims. The 'What is not covered' section lists exclusions for equipment/goods loss unless tied to a valid vehicle claim, damage before journey start, lack of proper locking, theft at factory/office premises, and pre-existing damage, with a limit of 25% of IDV or Rs. 100,000 and a deductible of 10% of claim or Rs. 10,000. The TA03 Additional Transportation Expenses section covers costs for hiring alternate vehicles and labour for loading/unloading if the insured vehicle is damaged and cannot move, subject to spot surveyor certification and actual bills, with liability capped at 50% if no spot survey and maximum sum insured. Limits are 5% of IDV or Rs. 25,000 for goods vehicles other than 3-wheelers, and 5% of IDV or Rs. 5,000 for 3-wheeler goods vehicles. Exclusions include windscreen-only claims, invalid Section 1 claims, pre-journey damage, damage within 100 kms of journey start for certain vehicles, repairable at spot, and no alternate vehicle hired. TA04 Loss of Income pays the scheduled amount if applicable. The page ends with TATA AIG company contact and registration details.

nodes.title: What is not Covered
nodes.summary: The text describes the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy, including UINs and a police report requirement for burglary, house-breaking, or theft claims. It details exclusions for equipment/goods with limits and deductibles, and covers three add-ons: TA03 Additional Transportation Expenses (covering alternate vehicle hire and loading/unloading costs with limits and exclusions), TA04 Loss of Income (paying daily amounts for vehicle under repair with duration and per-day limits by vehicle type, conditions, and exclusions), and TA05 EMI Protector (paying EMIs during repair with limits, conditions, and exclusions).

nodes.title: Commercial Vehicle Policy: Income Loss and EMI Protector Coverage
nodes.summary: This page covers two sections of a commercial vehicle policy: loss of income coverage and EMI Protector. Loss of income pays for 20 days (non-total loss) or 30 days (total loss including theft/constructive total loss) when the insured vehicle is under repair due to a covered peril, with daily limits based on vehicle type. Cover starts after 3 days for three-wheelers/taxis and 5 days for other commercial vehicles from garage arrival, ending when repairs complete or re-inspection occurs. A police report is required for total loss, theft, burglary, or house-breaking claims. Exclusions include invalid Section 1 claims. Special condition requires vehicle in commercial use for 30 days prior to accident. EMI Protector pays EMIs during repair if damage from covered peril and repair time exceeds 7 days, limited to 2 months EMI or sum insured, requiring EMI schedule and payment track record. Exclusions include invalid Section 1 claims, windscreen/glass-only damage, total loss or theft, and more than one covered incident.

nodes.title: What is not Covered
nodes.summary: The text describes several coverages under the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy. It details loss of income coverage for vehicles under repair due to covered perils, specifying payment durations for total loss versus other claims, cover commencement delays, and maximum daily payable amounts based on vehicle type. It requires a police report for certain claims and outlines exclusions and a special condition of minimum 30 days commercial use. The TA05 EMI Protector covers EMIs during repair if damage is from a covered peril and repair exceeds 7 days, limited to 2 months EMI or sum insured, with requirements for financier-certified EMI schedule and payment track record, and lists exclusions. TA06 covers repair of glass, fiber, plastic, and rubber parts without affecting No Claim Bonus under conditions, excluding painting costs without other repairs. TA07 provides additional TPPD cover for damage to third-party property caused by the insured vehicle, up to a specified limit in excess of Section II. TA08 Engine Secure covers repair/replacement of internal engine, gearbox, transmission, or differential parts due to water ingress or oil leakage, including lubricating oils/consumables excluding fuel, with exclusions for warranty, maintenance, aggravation, and wear and tear, and a special condition that is truncated.

nodes.title: Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy Services Overview
key_items: Towing in case of incorrect fuelling:
nodes.summary: The page outlines the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy, detailing services for vehicle breakdowns and accidents. It covers the arrangement of an alternate vehicle if repairs exceed 72 hours, with costs borne by the insured. Emergency towing assistance is provided for breakdowns, accidents, and incorrect fuelling, with specific distance limits and additional costs if exceeded. For MCV/HCV, load transfer coordination is offered, though the service provider is not responsible for service quality. Concierge services include SMS relays for urgent messages. Continuation or return journey via taxi support is arranged if the vehicle cannot be repaired the same day, with taxi fare paid by the insured. Hotel accommodation assistance is also provided near the breakdown location.

nodes.title: Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy Assistance and Limitations
nodes.summary: The page outlines the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy, detailing assistance services such as picking up repaired vehicles after breakdowns outside the home city, with driver costs borne by the insured. An important note clarifies that labor and conveyance costs are covered, but material costs are not, and reimbursement up to specified limits is provided if assistance is not received. Geographical territory specifies service availability on national and state highways and motorable roads in mainland India, excluding certain states, with distance limits based on vehicle type. Limitations include best-effort service, exclusions for acts of God, war, etc., no coverage for luggage damage, vehicle misuse, and non-transport of certain loads.
